semiconductor_relevance: High — Dou Yee Enterprises provides specialized materials and solutions for the semiconductor industry, including electrostatic discharge control and cleanroom apparel.
summary: Dou Yee Enterprises is a global provider of industrial solutions, specializing in materials and services for the semiconductor, data storage, electronics, and biomedical industries. They manufacture electronics packaging materials with properties for static discharge and humidity control, as well as cleanroom apparel and footwear, ensuring compliance with international quality standards.
capabilities: Dry Packaging and Electronic Packaging Materials
